title: Contents Packout & Storage Reset Carry Percentage for Units
content:
**Q. Does setting furniture in an apartment or condominium cost more than in a house?**

A. Yes. Setting furniture inside a unit costs more than inside a house. On the Contents Packout & Storage furniture reset line of a return, when the company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is for a multifamily unit property, the furniture reset rate carries the multifamily reset carry percentage; when it is for a condo unit property, the condo reset carry percentage; when it is for any other property type, or no company rebuild contract is read at that address, no reset carry percentage applies.

**Q. What are the percentages?**

| Property type on the Reconstruction contract read | Reset carry percentage on the furniture reset rate |
|---|---|
| multifamily unit | 15 percent |
| condo unit | 8 percent |
| other, or no contract read | none |

**Q. Which contract is read?**

A. The company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is the one at that address on the job's own claim file, or with no claim file when the job has none, and among those the one furthest along, taking a closed contract first, then a final invoiced, substantially complete, in construction, permitted, signed and proposed one in that order; a cancelled contract is never read; the company keeps one rebuild contract per claim file and address, added scope for the same claim and address being written as a change order on it, so no two contracts share that place in the order.

**Q. An example?**

A. With a reset rate taken as 20.00 for the illustration, a condo unit contract makes it 21.60 per piece.
